headline: Opinion: Connor Hellebuyck's Words To Jets Fans After Trade To Devils Ring Hollow
take:
The Hockey News published an opinion piece saying Connor Hellebuyck's words to Jets fans after his trade to the New Jersey Devils "ring hollow." The outlet says the goalie spoke Saturday and tried to mend fences with fans who feel betrayed.

The numbers say the Devils needed this. NJD sit at 7-4-0 with 14 points, and they have controlled play so far this season, with a 60 percent share of expected goals (a measure of chance quality, where 50 is even). The results trail the play, though. They are 4.7 goals below what their chances should have produced, and their goaltending is 5 goals below expected by goals saved above expected, which compares saves made to saves a typical goalie would make on the same shots. A goalie who stops the shots he should is the missing piece.

WPG are the reverse. They are 4-3-3 with 46 percent of expected goals, yet their goaltending is 5.6 goals above expected. That is a team getting more from its goalie than its play has earned, so the Jets' record may be hard to hold without him.
